tha-ap224:1.1: Ajinadāyaka.] Ekatiṃse ito kappe gaṇasantharako ahaṃ / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddham āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ. // //
tha-ap224:2.1: cammakhaṇḍaṃ mayā dinnaṃ Sikhino lokabandhuno / tena kammena dipadinda lokajeṭṭha narāsabha // //
tha-ap224:3.1: Sampattim anubhotvāna kilese jhāpayim ahaṃ / dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane. // //
tha-ap224:4.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe ajinaṃ yam adās' ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ajinassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap224:5.1: Ito *pañcamake* kappe rājā āsi Sudāyako / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap224:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Ajinadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
